settings.label: How do I join?
settings.text: Create an account and the program opens automatically. There is nothing extra to buy or install.

settings.label: Where do I spend points?
settings.text: At checkout there is a rewards dropdown. Choose an amount and the discount applies to your cart.

settings.label: Do points expire?
settings.text: They hang around until you go six months without placing an order.

settings.label: What if I return something?
settings.text: Points earned on the returned item are removed from your balance.

settings.label: Why has my birthday gift not shown up?
settings.text: Birthday points arrive thirty days after you add your date, to keep the program fair.
